title: Scutterfluff: Turf Wars is now open for testers on Google Play! Cozy RTS, fluffy animals vs bugs
author: ztyian1021
selftext:
Hi all! Scutterfluff: Turf Wars, the game we've been making, is now open for testers on Google Play! It's a cozy RTS where fluffy animal clans battle bugs.



We're on day 16 of development. In about two weeks it went from a first playable version to 110+ updates and three game modes. Full disclosure: I used AI tools (Claude, Meshy, GPT) for coding and assets, with my own art direction on top.



Modes:

\- Classic: build your base, train units, take the map

\- Hero Clash: 3v3 hero battles with a boss

\- Lantern Night: co-op survival through waves of critters



Where we are: Google needs 12 testers for 14 days before public launch. We're at 2 of 12, so every tester counts! It's free to join.



How to join (Android):

1. Join the tester group, signed in with your Google account: [https://groups.google.com/g/scutterfluff-testers](https://groups.google.com/g/scutterfluff-testers)

2. Open this link with the same account, tap "Become a tester", then install: [https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.scutterfluff.turfwars](https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.scutterfluff.turfwars)



Tips:

\- Your Play Store app has to use that same Google account, or you'll see "Item not found".

\- If the group page only shows "Sign in", open it in Chrome instead of the Reddit app's browser.

\- Please keep it installed for about 2 weeks.



Any feedback, bugs or ideas are super welcome. Thanks!
